title: Hoover Dam — USA
description: Colorado River, 726 ft arch-gravity dam, 2,080 MW, completed 1935 — the Depression-era icon.

title: Three Gorges Dam — China
description: Yangtze River, 607 ft gravity dam, 22,500 MW, completed 2012 — the largest power station on Earth.

title: Itaipu Dam — Brazil/Paraguay
description: Paraná River, 643 ft gravity dam, 14,000 MW, 1984 — the binational giant.

title: Grand Coulee Dam — USA
description: Columbia River, 550 ft gravity dam, 6,809 MW, 1942 — the largest US power station.

title: Aswan High Dam — Egypt
description: Nile River, 364 ft rock-fill dam, 2,100 MW, 1970 — tamed the Nile's flood.

title: Kariba Dam — Zambia/Zimbabwe
description: Zambezi River, 420 ft arch dam, completed 1959 — the great arch of southern Africa.

title: Nurek Dam — Tajikistan
description: Vakhsh River, 984 ft embankment dam, 3,015 MW, 1979 — the world's tallest dam.

title: Jinping-I Dam — China
description: Yalong River, 1,000 ft arch dam, 3,600 MW, 2013 — the world's tallest arch dam.
